facts.fact: CIPESA says Zimbabwe experienced network degradation during its 2023 elections; the document does not say who ordered it, where, or when it ended.

systems.system: Offences of false information, cyberbullying, incitement, insulting the President, sovereignty and national interest

note: Says journalists and critics in Zimbabwe face arrest generally, with no person, date or case named, so no penalty fact; the Uganda shutdown is not ZWE. The UPR submission by ZLHR and partners is itself civil-society criticism but of no named policy, bill or decision.
